_doc: Killed mechanisms. Query before every expensive hypothesis (bible §19). A new architecture reopens a kill only if it invalidates the old premise.

entries.premise: a global low-rank factorisation of a dense transformer body transfers to the next body
entries.killed_by: Qwen3.8 dense low-rank failure (legacy, retired patient)
entries.verdict: DEAD on that dense body. Does NOT automatically kill cross-expert low-rank structure in MoE.
entries.reopen_if: the new architecture invalidates the old premise (bible §19)

entries.mechanism: pure implementation bug killed by mathematics
entries.premise: the mathematics of the representation is unchanged
entries.verdict: Stay dead unless the representation changed the mathematics.

entries.premise: a short prompt set is enough to estimate expert frequency
entries.killed_by: at 88 tokens the median routing split is only 63.6 percent stable and 26.1 percent of cells never route at all
entries.verdict: the lever is alive, the 88-token calibration is dead; needs ~1000 calibration tokens disjoint from holdout

entries.mechanism: expert templates + deltas in row-normalized space; same-expert-index cross-layer tying
entries.premise: experts share a template; same-index experts tie across depth
entries.killed_by: raw and row-normalized mean |off-diagonal cosine| agree to 3 sig figs (0.00166 vs 0.00168). Best single shared template explains 0.2513 of 4 experts' energy against an orthogonal null of 0.2500. Same-expert-index cross-layer tying indistinguishable from a different-index control at 1e-7.
entries.verdict: DEAD, and the row-norm rescue hypothesis is falsified.
entries.does_not_automatically_kill: cross-expert low-rank on a parent that actually has shared structure (see reopen_if)
entries.reopen_if: a parent measures row-normalized mean off-diagonal expert cosine >= 0.10

entries.mechanism: entropy coding of trained PQ indices
entries.killed_by: measured 0.0 to 0.7 percent, not the hoped 10 to 25 percent; Lloyd-optimal indices are near-uniform by construction
entries.verdict: the gain is inside the noise of the byte plan
entries.does_not_automatically_kill: entropy coding of NON-Lloyd (biased or stratified) codebooks
entries.reopen_if: a future parent uses NON-Lloyd (biased or stratified) codebooks whose measured index entropy is <= 0.9 of uniform

entries.mechanism: reconstruct an omitted MoE expert from a learned combination of surviving experts
entries.premise: a cold expert's function lives in a low-dimensional surviving-expert subspace
entries.killed_by: median held-out relative error of the BEST single surviving expert is 0.885/0.993/0.995 at L0/L3/L7; a 4-survivor least-squares merge only reaches 0.863/0.988/0.995. ~1.0 means the reconstruction is no better than predicting zero.
entries.verdict: DEAD. Upheld under adversarial attack (in-sample contamination ran in the merge's favour).
entries.reopen_if: a parent measures best-single-survivor reconstruction error <= 0.5 on held-out routed tokens at its own keep fraction

entries.mechanism: delta coding / shared low-rank bases / cluster-mean subtraction across experts
entries.premise: experts share a low-dimensional component that can be subtracted
entries.killed_by: mean pairwise cosine between experts = 1e-4; experts are mutually orthogonal
entries.verdict: dead on arrival: there is no shared component to subtract
entries.does_not_automatically_kill: the same lever on a parent that is not orthogonal (bible §19: dense-body failure does not auto-kill MoE shared structure — AND the inverse: this kill does not auto-kill a parent with cosine >= 0.10)
entries.reopen_if: a future parent measures mean pairwise expert cosine >= 0.10 on its own weights

entries.mechanism: Kronecker / tensor-product factorisation W ~ A (x) B of a single expert tensor
entries.premise: the Van Loan spectrum is peaked enough that a low-rank Kronecker captures the organ
entries.killed_by: at depth the Van Loan rearrangement spectrum is nearly flat — top Kronecker component holds 0.27 percent of gate energy; rank the 2.5 bpw budget buys captures only 27.2 percent of energy.
entries.verdict: DEAD for layers >= 1 at the S64 rungs; LIVE and codec-beating on layer 0 (named exception).
entries.does_not_automatically_kill: layer-0 Kronecker (measured 0.0301 vs incumbent 0.2252 rel_error at cheaper complete BPW)
entries.reopen_if: any layer whose Van Loan spectrum is not flat; check before assuming depth behaviour transfers to the first block

entries.mechanism: aggressive expert cache (64GB cap) for a single lockstep pass
entries.premise: a large RAM cache pays because experts reuse across layers in one lockstep pass
entries.killed_by: 0 evictions at a 64GB cap; RAM 70->18GB free and swap down to 906MB free. A single lockstep pass has zero cross-layer reuse
entries.verdict: correct cap is ~20GB; aggressive RAM only where real reuse exists
entries.does_not_automatically_kill: an expert cache on a schedule with MEASURED cross-layer reuse
entries.reopen_if: a future parent's schedule has MEASURED cross-layer expert reuse (cache hit rate > 0) instead of a single lockstep pass

entries.mechanism: treating all layers as one coding problem
entries.premise: one codec / one rate map is near-optimal across depth
entries.killed_by: nothing — this is a POSITIVE entry recording where the campaign found real headroom. Layer 0 is a different source.
entries.verdict: LIVE AND CONVERGENT. Do not transfer 'Lane A is closed' to layer 0.
entries.reopen_if: N/A — live. Scope is bounded: layer 0 is 1/94 of that parent (~1 percent of bits). Value is as a diagnostic.

entries.mechanism: any post-hoc fixed-weight codec improvement at a fixed sub-bit index rate
entries.premise: matching the Gaussian D(R) proves the codec has reached the floor
entries.killed_by: mid/late layers ARE essentially Gaussian (non-Gaussianity 0.012-0.018 bits), so there the original conclusion survives: down sits 0.059 decades from its true Shannon bound. The Gaussian D(R) is an UPPER bound, not a floor.
entries.verdict: NEARLY exhausted, NOT closed. CORRECTED from an earlier overclaim. Layer 0 is the named exception.
entries.does_not_automatically_kill: an organ- and layer-specific codec for the first block; any method that CHANGES the source
entries.reopen_if: any cell measuring >= 0.5 decades of gap to its OWN Shannon lower bound (measured differential entropy, not Gaussian)

entries.mechanism: post-hoc scalar gain correction on a PQ artifact
entries.premise: a scalar gain on the reconstruction can recover magnitude the codebook dropped
entries.killed_by: optimal gain pinned at exactly 1.0; k-means reconstruction is a conditional mean so the residual is orthogonal to the reconstruction, and cosine is gain-invariant
entries.does_not_automatically_kill: gain correction on a NON-conditional-mean quantizer
entries.reopen_if: a future parent uses a NON-conditional-mean quantizer whose residual is measurably non-orthogonal to the reconstruction

entries.mechanism: PQ/VQ coding of the RAW weights as the route to one bit or below
entries.premise: a higher-rate raw-weight codebook will eventually work
entries.killed_by: qwen3-235b:F1 real forward, 6 prompts, 94 layers: A1_1p0 at 1.0075 BPW collapsed 6/6; R2_subhalf at 0.4930 BPW collapsed 6/6
entries.verdict: the raw-weight PQ/VQ family is dead at about one bit. This kills THAT FAMILY, not the sub-bit program.
entries.does_not_automatically_kill: a method that CHANGES the source (QAT, distillation, compressibility training, structured pruning, learned sharing)
entries.reopen_if: never on raw weights. A method that changes the source is not this lever and is not blocked by this entry

entries.premise: 94 percent of gate/up rows collapse onto ONE codeword because row norms span 1e-5..0.91
entries.killed_by: the PREMISE does not reproduce. Measured single-codeword share is 0.0267 mean and never exceeds 0.047 at the deployed d16 k1024 geometry. The 94 percent figure belonged to a different (k=32) geometry.
entries.verdict: the stated pathology is absent; stratification has nothing to fix. Its stronger form (per-row scale normalization) helps only 2.8 percent mean.
entries.does_not_automatically_kill: scale-invariant VQ (quantize direction, ship one bf16 scale per row) — alive, small
entries.reopen_if: a parent measures single-codeword share >= 0.20 at its own deployed geometry

entries.premise: ternary factors beat VQ at matched rate
entries.killed_by: loses to VQ at matched rate
entries.verdict: dominated at every matched rate tested
entries.reopen_if: a future parent diagnoses a weight distribution where ternary beats VQ at a matched exact rate on a real forward

entries.mechanism: uniform sub-bit allocation across organs (and its treated variant)
entries.premise: organs degrade together, so a uniform rate map is fair
entries.killed_by: F0 real forward: both the uniform and the treated artifact collapsed
entries.verdict: superseded by organ inversion (mlp1 gate+up sensitive, mlp2 down tolerant), confirmed by F1 qwen3-235b dominant_failure_organ = gate
entries.reopen_if: a future parent measures NO organ sensitivity split (gate and down degrade within 10 percent of each other)
